employment (69%) than the national average of 76%;360 the highest unemployment for
young people (aged 16 to 24) was amongst those identifying as Caribbean;361 nearly half live
in social housing; over half of parents are lone parents;362 and 13.2% of black workers were
in the least skilled type of occupation,363 associated with lower economic circumstances (in
comparison with 9.4% of the general population).364
Criminal justice system

18. Black people are the most overrepresented in the criminal justice system (they comprise
12% of the prison population but only 4% of the overall population).365 In the year ending 31
March 2023, black people were 2.2 times as likely to be arrested as white people.366 In the
criminal justice arena, the 1981 Scarman report367 concluded that racial disadvantage was a
fact of British life and highlighted the need for urgent action to address racial disadvantage.
